summary: F1 fixed in DockerImages 0af47c9: RcloneBackend.lsjson no longer maps stderr text ('not found'/'no such') to an empty listing; only rclone's directory-not-found exit code 3 does, and only for List (scope folders, prune), while ListDirs (the watcher's remote root) and every other rclone failure return an error, so the watcher keeps its last streams and does not advance last success. Regression test pipeline/backend_test.go (stub rclone; failed on the old code for DNS, missing config, Drive 404 and missing root), checked against a real rclone v1.75.1; gofmt, vet, tidy, go test -race ./... green (Go 1.26, and 1.24); done-record updated (AnsibleSpecs), Delete's same substring issue logged as close-out B4.
